question: Can one of the empty-square arm's conditions be loosened so the desk buys the same kind of trade sooner without losing value per trade?
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-10-28: 'I want to preserve all of the value we get from the strategy, but optimize it so we can trim that nine minutes', then 'Yes, prereg now' (loosen one condition at a time, measure signed entry timing and per-trade value vs the current desk and a matched random control; runs after stale_age_replay).
registered_at: 2026-10-28 ~07:40 ET, before any code or replay for this study.
origin: Recent pre-buy proxy (10/16-10/27, 239 buys, 15 minutes before each fill): exh_not_tight 4.33 min/buy, exh_falling 3.57, wait_exh 1.22, plus ~1.7 in the new gates' refusals. Every tested earlier-signal entry was ~random (pitch studies, %R trend trade, mid-rise -50, FIRST_PRESQ on IEX), so this study keeps the square and only loosens its own thresholds. The live arm (ai_entry_watch.py presquare check ~12540-12580): both lines >= -ai_watch_exh_pre_thr (35), |fast - slow| <= rte_confluence_max (15), fast not falling / not cooling, fast rising (else exh_not_rising), streak >= ai_watch_square_min_count (1); ai_watch_presquare_only true, ai_watch_exh_presquare_arm true.
prior: Each loosening buys earlier at a point the square has not yet confirmed; past early variants lost their selection value. Prior: timing 1-3 min earlier, value change 0 to -5 bp per trade.

change.knobs: NEW arm-only knobs read ONLY inside the pre-square arm check (default unset = the shared value, live unchanged): ai_watch_presquare_confluence_max (overrides rte_confluence_max there), ai_watch_presquare_pre_thr (overrides ai_watch_exh_pre_thr there), ai_watch_presquare_require_rising (default true; false lets a flat-but-not-falling fast line arm). rte_confluence_max and ai_watch_exh_pre_thr themselves, and every other use of them (seat classes, eviction, full square, admission, overlays), are unchanged.
change.tests: Unit tests: knobs unset = identical decisions; each knob changes only the pre-square verdict; exh_seat_class and eviction decisions are identical with each knob set.

variants.REF: The current live desk, pinned exactly as stale_age_replay's REF (late_gates_run.PIN regime + wr_trend 15, 5m veto, slope-now gate with missing pitch passing, tape gap rule 1.5 / 60), arm ceiling at its live value; if stale_age_replay has already PASSED and the operator switched its knob on, REF includes it (declared before the first run).
variants.RAND_v_k: For each primary v, k = 1..3: REF + a NEW knob ai_watch_presquare_rand_release_share with salt 'SQ-v-k', which lets a pre-square check that REF refuses for that variant's condition (v's own refusal code: exh_not_tight for TIGHT20, wait_exh for PRE45, exh_not_rising for FLATOK) arm at random (sha256(salt|symbol|day|check ts) < share); share calibrated per session by bisection (<= 4 passes per seed set) until the seed-averaged released-check count is within +-10% of v's released-check count. Counts come from a poll-site counter like stale_age's arm_age_counts.
variants.MDE1: REF + the random release at a fixed 25% of all three refusal codes, salt 'SQ-MDE'.
variants.REF_DUP: REF twice on the first, middle and last scored session.

harness: stale_age_replay's exactly: tools/replay_session.py --start 09:00 --end 15:50 --step 2.0 --engine recorded --exits live --arm-age-from-prints with ai_watch_arm_age_mode 'age', one pinned sha; entry price = the first SIP trade after the replayed decision within 60 s (fetched after the close; no print counted, > 10% excludes a session, failed fetch = not scored); ret = replay exit / SIP entry - 1; open_at_end marked at the SIP 15:49 close; full SIP spread charged.
fidelity_gate: Before any variant: 2026-10-27 REF replay vs live decision_ledger arm rows: counts of last_presquare arms, exh_not_tight, exh_falling, wait_exh and exh_not_rising refusals each 50-200% of live's; buy recall >= 0.85. Else NOT TESTABLE.
sessions: Half A = recorded sessions 2026-09-28..2026-10-27 (22); half B = forward sessions from the first session after this file is READY, at least 10. Read after half B reaches 10. A session needs >= 5 REF trades. Runs after stale_age_replay's replays, one batch at a time, after hours only.
statistic: Per variant v and session: lift_ref = mean net(v) - mean net(REF); lift_rand = mean net(v) - mean over seeds of mean net(RAND_v); TIMING = signed median of v - REF entry seconds over one-to-one matched pairs (same symbol, nearest within +-600 s, greedy by distance), negative = earlier; MOVED SHARE = share of REF trades whose match moved >= 30 s or vanished; lift on MOVED trades alone. t and bounds day-clustered (std_scorer.day_stat).
pass: Per primary v, Bonferroni over 3 primaries (one-sided bounds at 1 - 0.05/3). v PASSES (faster, value kept) if ALL of: TIMING <= -1.0 min; MOVED SHARE >= 10%; the lower bound of lift_ref (repriced on SIP entries) >= -3 bp in BOTH halves; lift on MOVED trades >= -5 bp; lift_rand >= 0 (v beats a random release of the same number of refused checks); >= 300 REF and >= 300 v trades; power floors met. A v that passes and also has lift_ref >= +3 with t >= 2.24 in both halves is reported as 'faster and better'.
fail: Any primary missing a condition fails; a lift_ref <= 0 with its upper bound < -3 bp in either half is 'costs value'.
power: MDE per half = 3.08 x max(sd_session(RAND_v avg - REF), sd_session(MDE1 - REF)) / sqrt(sessions in the half) must be <= 6 bp for the non-inferiority bound to mean anything; else UNDERPOWERED, no verdict; cap 40 sessions (then UNDERPOWERED = FAIL).
if_pass: result-skeptic Mode 3, then the operator decides whether to switch that knob live (after the close). If more than one passes, they are not combined without a new test.
if_fail: Keep the square as it is; record which conditions are buying their minutes (the wait is the price of the selection).
no_retuning: No other threshold is scored as primary; TIGHT25 is information only.
script: The three arm-only knobs, the random-release knob and its counter in ai_entry_watch.py (defaults = live), runner tools/studies/square_relax_run.py and scorer tools/studies/square_relax_read.py (reusing stale_age_run / stale_age_read), written after this file is committed and after a result-skeptic READY; they may not change anything above.
multiplicity: 3 primaries, Bonferroni. TIGHT25 and every information line have no pass.

amended.when: 2026-10-28 ~08:05 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST (11 findings), before any code or replay. The value margin M is the operator's to confirm (finding 11).
amended.1_pools: With the full square on (ai_watch_exh_square_arm true), exhaustion_allows_buy returns the full square's code for a pre-square miss, and the pre-square check itself returns wait_exh (not exh_not_tight) for a wide gap. So variants and controls are defined on the PRE-SQUARE'S OWN CONDITIONS, not on ledger codes: a check is in v's pool when both lines are present, the fast line is rising and not falling/cooling, the streak rule is met, and the ONLY failed pre-square condition is v's (TIGHT20: gap in (15, 20] with both lines >= -35; PRE45: gap <= 15 with the lower line in [-45, -35)). RAND_v releases checks from v's pool only; a released or v-accepted check returns 'presquare' and still meets every later gate.
amended.2_flatok: FLATOK is dropped (exh_not_rising occurs 0 times in ~70k live arm rows 10/13-10/27: rising/falling are strict comparisons). Primaries: TIGHT20 and PRE45, Bonferroni over 2 (one-sided bounds at 1 - 0.05/2). PRE40 (pre-band -40) is added as information, the neighbour of PRE45.
amended.3_timing: TIMING = signed median AND mean of v - REF entry seconds over MOVED pairs only (matched pairs whose entries differ by >= 30 s); vanished REF trades and new v trades are counted separately and do not count toward MOVED SHARE, which is (moved matched pairs) / REF trades.
amended.4_arm_only_scope: Declared: the verdict change alters rec block_code, which seat eviction (_is_unarmable_stale_watching; ai_watch_unarmable_evict_sec 30) and the paint read, so seat retention is part of the treatment. Evictions per session per variant are logged and reported. book_server.py's own seat thresholds (35 / 15) are unchanged. The unit test asserts the knobs change only the pre-square verdict; it no longer claims eviction is identical.
amended.5_funnel: Information, per variant per session: checks released at pre-square -> passed slope-now -> passed wr_trend 15 -> passed after_square -> passed the 5m veto -> armed -> filled. if_fail's 'the wait is the price of the selection' is written only if most released checks reach an arm.
amended.6_fidelity: Compare the 10/27 REF replay with live as SHARES of arm rows by code (live rows are sampled ~12.5 s per symbol, the replay every 2 s), each code's share within 0.5-2x; buy recall >= 0.85; and on matched buys the signed median of replay minus live arm time within +-10 s (10/27 fidelity.json offsets).
amended.7_unmatched: If RAND_v cannot be count-matched (+-10% released checks) in more than a third of scored sessions, v's verdict is CONTROL UNMATCHED (UNPROVEN), not FAIL.
amended.8_defined: Trade floors are per half: >= 120 REF and >= 120 v trades in each half. The moved-trade test is a point estimate per half: mean net of moved v trades minus their matched REF trades >= -5 bp in both halves. Bounds use t at n_sessions - 1 degrees of freedom (day-clustered). REF_DUP: if any duplicated session differs by > 1 bp/trade, the margin M tightens by that amount.
amended.9_sensitivity: A passing primary is reported FAIL if its neighbour (TIGHT25 for TIGHT20, PRE40 for PRE45) reads 'costs value' (upper bound of lift_ref < -M in either half). Drop-top-3-sessions and drop-top-5-names lift_ref are reported; a pass whose drop-top-3 lift_ref falls below -M is reported as concentrated.
amended.10_power: If the MDE floor is met but the bound misses -M with lift_ref's point estimate >= 0, the verdict is UNPROVEN (not FAIL).
amended.11_margin: PASS requires the lower bound of lift_ref (SIP-repriced) >= -M in BOTH halves, where M is the operator's non-inferiority margin, recorded here before any run (proposed M = 2 bp; the desk's whole net per trade is about -3.5 bp, so 3 bp would be too loose for 'preserve all of the value').
amended.supersedes: variants FLATOK and RAND_v pool definitions, TIMING and MOVED SHARE, fidelity_gate, the trade floors, the -3 bp margin, multiplicity (now 2 primaries).

margin.when: 2026-10-28 ~08:20 ET, before any code or replay
margin.rule: M = 2 bp. A primary v PASSES only if, in BOTH halves, the lower bound of lift_ref (SIP-repriced, day-clustered, one-sided at 1 - 0.05/2) >= -2 bp AND lift_ref's point estimate >= 0, together with every other condition in pass / amended. REF_DUP tightens M as in amended #8.

amended_2.when: 2026-10-28 ~06:55 ET, after result-skeptic round 2 FIX FIRST (6 findings), before any code or replay. Two-round rule: READY is the operator's decision.
amended_2.1_rand_pool: RAND_v draws from one declared WIDER pool shared by both primaries: pre-square checks with both lines present, fast rising and not falling/cooling, not both >= -rte_threshold (20), that fail EXACTLY ONE pre-square condition inside the envelope gap <= 25 and lower line >= -50 (i.e. gap in (15, 25] with both >= -35, or gap <= 15 with the lower line in [-50, -35)). RAND_v_k releases checks from that pool at random, count-matched (+-10%) to v's released checks. lift_rand >= 0 therefore asks whether v's specific condition is safer to drop than a random same-sized release from the envelope.
amended_2.2_tight_scope: ai_watch_presquare_confluence_max replaces 15 in BOTH tightness uses inside the pre-square check (the 'both_ob and tight' full-square exclusion and the 'not tight' test, ~12562-12565), so a both-overbought check is still not a pre-square. TIGHT20's own pool is gap in (15, 20], both lines >= -35, not both >= -20, rising, not falling; TIGHT25's is gap in (15, 25] likewise.
amended_2.3_mde1: MDE1 = REF + a random release of a fixed 25% of the amended_2 #1 envelope pool (salt 'SQ-MDE').
amended_2.4_half_b: Half B counts SCORED sessions (>= 5 REF trades each) from the first session after READY; the read needs >= 10 scored sessions AND >= 120 REF and >= 120 v trades in half B. If 10 scored sessions give fewer than 120 trades, half B extends session by session (trade counts only, no lift read) up to 20 scored sessions; still short = UNDERPOWERED.
amended_2.5_fidelity_zero: Fidelity share ratios apply only to codes with >= 1% of live arm rows on 10/27; rarer codes (e.g. exh_not_rising, live share 0) use an absolute tolerance: replay share <= 1%.
amended_2.6_loose_ends: TIMING passes when BOTH the median and the mean over moved pairs are <= -1.0 min. The 'fail' block's -3 bp is replaced by -M (M = 2 bp, margin block). 'Faster and better' requires lift_ref >= +3 bp with one-sided t >= 2.0 at Bonferroni over 2 (t >= 2.24 two-sided-equivalent replaced by the 1 - 0.05/2 one-sided critical value at n-1 df). A released check advances _presquare_streak_note exactly as a natural pre-square pass does.

ready.text: READY: square_relax amended r2; primaries TIGHT20, PRE45; M = 2 bp lower bound and estimate >= 0 in both halves; RAND on the declared single-condition envelope pool; half B >= 10 scored sessions, extended (trade count only) to >= 120 trades, cap 20.

screen_first.when: 2026-10-28 ~07:30 ET, before any variant run or result, at the operator's request: 'Maybe it might be worth deciding if it's a good idea before investing 10 sessions on it.'
screen_first.stage_1_screen: The 22 recorded sessions 2026-09-28..2026-10-27 are split by count in date order into an EARLY half (first 11) and a LATE half (last 11). The study's own pass rule is applied with EARLY and LATE as the two halves (same statistics, controls, margins, Bonferroni, power floors). Declared weakness: these days fed the lag diagnostics that motivated the study, so this is a screen, not a confirmation.
screen_first.screen_outcomes: SCREEN FAIL (or UNDERPOWERED, or CONTROL UNMATCHED) on the recorded days: the study stops there; no forward sessions are spent and nothing is switched on. SCREEN PASS: the original half-B confirmation on >= 10 forward sessions (as amended) is run; the operator decides at that point whether the change also runs live on paper during the confirmation, under a switch-off rule written into this file before any switch.
screen_first.supersedes: The original half A / half B roles: half A becomes the stage-1 screen (split EARLY / LATE); half B (forward) becomes stage-2 confirmation, run only after a screen pass.

stage2_monitoring.when: 2026-10-28 ~07:40 ET, before any run, at the operator's request: 'Instead of 10 new sessions, can we measure our progress after one and see if it makes sense to continue.'
stage2_monitoring.scope: Stage 2 (forward confirmation) only, after a stage-1 screen pass. Early stopping is ONE-SIDED: toward stop/off only. A PASS is never declared before the full stage-2 sample (>= 10 scored sessions, as amended).
stage2_monitoring.harm_check_every_session: After each forward session the scorer runs v vs REF on that session alone (and, if the change is live on paper, live vs the same day replayed without it). STOP (and switch off if live) if any of: no timing gain (median signed timing over moved pairs >= 0 min); v trades < 70% of REF trades that session; that session's per-trade lift_ref < -10 bp.
stage2_monitoring.futility_check_from_session_3: From the 3rd forward session, STOP if the cumulative stage-2 lift_ref's UPPER one-sided bound (same alpha as the pass rule) is < 0, i.e. the change cannot plausibly finish 'no worse'.
stage2_monitoring.reporting: Every session's check is written to OUT/stage2_checks.jsonl with the numbers before the next session starts; a STOP is final for this study.

amended_slope_off.change: Before any replay of this study had run (no ~/replay_runs output on the mini): the REF desk's slope-now gate is pinned OFF (ai_watch_slope_now_gate false; ai_watch_slope_now_missing_refuses irrelevant when off), matching the live desk since 2026-10-28 06:44 ET (45c4b937, operator turned the gate off before the open). Every other pin, variant, control, rule and threshold is unchanged. Reason: the original REF pinned the gate as live at registration; scoring against a desk that is no longer run would not answer the question. square_relax's REF is pinned 'exactly as stale_age_replay's REF', so it follows this change; the information funnel's 'passed slope-now' step passes every check.
